subject: Observability crosswalk / bridge eval — joint technical kickoff & checklist
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@datadog.com>, Matt Liu <matt.liu@grafana.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Observability crosswalk / bridge eval — joint technical kickoff & checklist

Hi Elena, Matt —

Thanks for agreeing to explore a joint technical evaluation to validate a Datadog <-> Grafana <-> Redwood bridge pattern for customers that want unified traces/metrics/logs across hosted and private deployments. High-level goal: produce a short compatibility matrix + reference pipeline and a 1-week hands-on eval that shows end-to-end traces and dashboard parity.

Proposed immediate asks to scope the kickoff:
- Technical contacts and preferred kickoff window (next week)
- A list of 3 representative telemetry sources (APM trace sample, OTLP metrics export, and logs)
- Retention and cardinality targets we should emulate for the eval
- Any existing OpenTelemetry Collector configs or pipeline snippets you recommend we try first

Deliverables we'll aim to produce together:
- bridge-compat-matrix.xlsx (compatibility matrix + known gaps)
- short SOW draft with success criteria (1-week lab, data samples, dashboard parity)
- runbook for exporter/collector settings that minimize cost while preserving latency SLOs

Ben/Vanessa — I'll own coordination from Redwood. Elena/Matt — can you share your initial availability and any pre-reqs (certs, service accounts) we should prepare?

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none in this initial note
From: Elena Park <elena@datadog.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability crosswalk / bridge eval — joint technical kickoff & checklist

Thanks Grace — this sounds great.

We can do a 60-min technical kickoff next Wed/Thu. For the eval, would suggest we focus on:
- APM trace export (sample traces for high-latency paths)
- OTLP metrics with histograms (to validate aggregation parity)

Pre-reqs from Datadog side:
- A service account token for a sandbox Datadog org (we can provide short-lived tokens)
- A sample trace/event payload (we can share a minimal synthetic trace)

I'll assign engineering: cc'd is Priya (Datadog infra) — she'll be on the kickoff.

Quick note: we have a known edge in agent-side trace enrichment; we want to validate whether Redwood's KV cache / batching changes event shaping for downstream trace IDs. If you can include a trace sample that includes baggage and user IDs that would help.

Elena Park
Partner Solutions Engineer, Datadog
elena@datadog.com

Cc: Rajesh Singh <rajesh@polarops.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability crosswalk / bridge eval — joint technical kickoff & checklist

Appreciate the invite, Grace. Grafana can support the dashboard parity piece and will provide a sample dashboard bundle and Loki/Tempo ingest configs.

A couple of things we'd like to confirm before kickoff:
- Will the eval run in a Redwood Dedicated sandbox (recommended) or as a hosted proof-of-concept? Dedicated will let us mirror private network constraints.
- We prefer to validate via an OpenTelemetry Collector pipeline (we'll share a baseline otel-collector-config.yaml) — please confirm which collector version you plan to run.

Cc'ing Rajesh from PolarOps (third-party consultancy) — Rajesh has worked on multi-backend collector pipelines and can help stitch exporters and processors in the lab.

Happy to do the kickoff Thurs 10:00–11:00 PT.

Thanks,
Matt Liu
Partner Engineering, Grafana Labs
matt.liu@grafana.com

Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability crosswalk / bridge eval — joint technical kickoff & checklist

Thanks all — locking Thursday 10:00–11:00 PT for the kickoff. Agenda and pre-kickoff checklist below. I've attached the compatibility matrix and a short SOW draft for review.

Agenda (60 min):
- Intros & success criteria (10m)
- Topology & network model (Redwood Dedicated vs hosted) (10m)
- OTEL pipeline & exporter configs (20m)
- Dashboards/queries to validate parity (10m)
- Next steps & lab schedule (10m)

Pre-kickoff checklist (what each side should provide before Thu kickoff):
- Datadog: short-lived sandbox token + synthetic trace payload (Elena)
- Grafana: example dashboard bundle + otel-collector baseline (Matt)
- Redwood: dedicated sandbox credentials, collector version and kernel/quantization profile we'll use, and initial KV cache settings (Grace)
- PolarOps: list of suggested processor/exporter tweaks for multi-backend setups (Rajesh)

Deliverables attached:
- bridge-compat-matrix.xlsx (compatibility matrix + gap notes)
- SOW-bridge-eval-draft.pdf (1-week lab, success criteria, sign-off)

Please review attachments and drop any redlines into the Drive folder. If everything looks good I'll send a calendar invite for Thu 10:00 PT and a short shared Drive with artifacts.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com

Attachments: bridge-compat-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), SOW-bridge-eval-draft.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability crosswalk / bridge eval — joint technical kickoff & checklist

Agree with the plan — quick pre-kickoff notes:
- I'll assemble a short pre-flight checklist for infra (sandbox creds, collector image, kernel/quantization profile) and share by EOD Fri.
- I'll also flag a test workload that simulates 1k rps with bursty traces so the team can validate batching/caching behavior.

On the call, let's make sure we capture any SLA/latency regression risks so we can include them in the SOW as acceptance criteria.

Ben Carter
Partnerships Sales | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
